{"id": "46afb918-428f-4cf3-90b6-0e5928c71cd4", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Bedrock spend in this account doesn't show a doubling. It went from $0 in September to about $129 in October. Either the doubling happened in another account (a payer or workload account) or last month's jump was the first real usage here. I can only see account 012345678901_1.

**October by cost driver (about $129 total)**

| Driver | Cost | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Sonnet 5 (input $27.00, output $24.56) | ~$51.56 | ~40% |
| AgentCore Runtime (vCPU $42.19, memory $6.40) | ~$48.59 | ~38% |
| Claude Opus 4.8, all regions | ~$28.62 | ~22% |
| Everything else (Sonnet 4.6, Nova, Titan, guardrails, GPT-5.6 at $0) | ~$0.25 | <1% |

- **Opus 4.8:** about $16.97 of its cost came from the Mumbai region (APS3) and about $11.65 from us-east-1. Cache writes were $14.73, against only $4.87 for cache reads.
- **November so far (Nov 1–23):** only about $13.80, almost all AgentCore. Model token spend has nearly vanished, so the October usage may have been a one-off burst.

**How to cut it**
1. **Sonnet 5 is the biggest token cost, and it shows no cache charges.** Turn on prompt caching for repeated system prompts, tool definitions and large shared context. Also check that output length is capped. Output tokens are about 48% of Sonnet's cost.
2. **Fix the Opus caching.** Writing to the cache costs about 3x what you spend reading from it. That usually means prefixes that change between calls, or caches that expire before they're reused. Stabilize the cached prefix, or stop caching on those calls.
3. **Route by task difficulty.** Send classification, extraction and simple tool-calling to Nova or Sonnet. Keep Opus for the hard reasoning steps. Nova Lite is already in use and costs almost nothing.
4. **Use batch inference** for anything that isn't latency-sensitive. It is billed at a discount.
5. **Review AgentCore Runtime.** The $42 in vCPU charges suggests sessions are left running or idle. Shorten session timeouts and check for sessions that never terminate.
6. **Check why Opus is running in Mumbai.** A second region with its own cache means cache hits are split between the two regions.

I can't tell from Cost Explorer which application, team or IAM role generated the Sonnet and Opus calls. That needs model invocation logging or per-application tagging. If you tell me which account holds the doubled bill, I can run the same breakdown there. I can also check whether invocation logging is enabled here.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
